description: Source code for managing post acknowledgements in Mattermost, including saving, deleting, retrieving acknowledgements, and sending websocket events for acknowledgement updates.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for managing post acknowledgements.

methods.name: SaveAcknowledgementForPost
methods.description: Saves an acknowledgement for a post by a user.

methods.name: saveAcknowledgementForPostWithPost
methods.description: Internal method to save acknowledgement with optional post object.

methods.name: DeleteAcknowledgementForPost
methods.description: Deletes a user's acknowledgement for a post.

methods.name: deleteAcknowledgementForPostWithPost
methods.description: Internal method to delete acknowledgement with optional post object.

methods.name: GetAcknowledgementsForPost
methods.description: Retrieves all acknowledgements for a specific post.

methods.name: GetAcknowledgementsForPostList
methods.description: Retrieves acknowledgements for a list of posts.

methods.name: SaveAcknowledgementsForPost
methods.description: Saves multiple acknowledgements for a post.

methods.name: sendAcknowledgementEvent
methods.description: Sends websocket event for acknowledgement added or removed.

methods.name: SaveAcknowledgementForPostWithModel
methods.description: Saves an acknowledgement using a PostAcknowledgement model.

methods.name: DeleteAcknowledgementForPostWithModel
methods.description: Deletes an acknowledgement using a PostAcknowledgement model.

methods.name: sendPostUpdateEvent
methods.description: Sends a post update event to trigger shared channel sync.
